events.info: Friday Night Live! - Improv Comedy in Miami Show It's JTF's special combination of shortform and longform improv! Enjoy as our award winning cast brings you fantastic improv that's perfect for your Friday night...LIVE! Our shows are often described as fast-paced improvised comedy. Think of it as Whose Line is It Anyway meets SNL with a lot of fun audience interaction along the way. Come be a part of the fun! Tickets are PER PERSON for this show. We will seat parties together in tables. We will do our best to sit larger groups as close as possible, but may have to split large groups if they arrive late. Tickets are NON REFUNDABLE after purchase. The show STARTS at 9pm and ENDS at around 10:50pm. Pre-show bar opens at 7:30pm with a pre-show stage show at 8pm at no additional cost if you want to arrive early.

events.info: Únete a mujeres de todas partes del mundo para una conferencia de dos días centrada en la Palabra de Dios. Juntas reflexionaremos en la esperanza segura del regreso de Cristo y en lo que esa verdad significa para la manera en que vivimos hoy, como mujeres formadas por la Palabra y llamadas a la fidelidad en medio de esta generación. Join women from around the world for a two-day conference centered on God's Word. Together we will reflect on the sure hope of Christ's return and what that truth means for how we live today, as women shaped by the Word and called to faithfulness in the midst of this generation.

events.name: PAIN OF TRUTH
events.info: PAIN OF TRUTH is more than just a band name, its a mantra for the Long Island, NY based hardcore band and their fans. Since 2020, Pain of Truth has been a driving force of the genre, blending old school sounds with new school swagger. The band signed to DAZE and came crushing out the gate with their 2020 No BlameJust Facts EP and 2023 full-length Not Through Blood, both boasting an impressive list of guest features from bands including Terror, Madball, Trapped Under Ice and King Nine. Following the release of 2025s Coast to Coast split with Sunami, Pain Of Truth entered the studio with GRAMMY winning producer Will Putney (Body Count, Incendiary, Counterparts) in early 2026 to craft their sophomore album, fittingly self-titled.When Pain Of Truth drops on DAZE in September 2026, expect to hear the bands sound amplified tenfold. Michael Smiths vocals reach new heights of aggression and charisma, echoed back by gang vocals on every track. Riffs move from dirty grooves to electrifying and the drums provide a pulsating rhythmic backbone made to intensify every mosh part.The record is the bands first truly collaborative release and first bout of longer material with absolutely zero guest features. Its a testament to Pain Of Truth doing things 100% their way and moving from a me vs. you mentality to us vs. them. The lyrics build from a place of resistance, struggle, and drive, attacking the unjust divisions in the world and fighting for a better reality.As the album covers weighty topics, the real heft comes in the songs being experienced in a live setting. At every show you can expect Smith and co directing fans to pile on in the front, jump off the stage, and position a chaotic pit behind it, ailing the horseshoe effect that plagues other acts. Their high energy shows have deemed Pain Of Truth a must see live band, and earned them spots touring alongside Knocked Loose, A Day To Remember, Terror, Madball, Speed, Counterparts, and High Vis to name a few. Theyvehad stand out sets at festivals across the world including Sound and Fury, Outbreak, Louder Than Life, Ieper Fest, Sick New World, and Vans Warped Tour. Heading toward the album release, Pain of Truth is set to play small venue shows on the east and west coast, before diving into a historical headline tour this fall. With their unstoppable drive and true to themselves approach, Pain Of Truth have been able to achieve in six years what takes other bands decades to accomplish. With the release of their self-titled second album, the band are continuing to cement a lasting impact in the world of hardcore and beyond.
